cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Here We Go Again
cards.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You promised to call. I kept dinner warm until eleven again. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Last time it was the train. Different explanation, same ruined dinner. Tomorrow I'm eating at seven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll borrow a phone next time. Please keep a plate for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's how I end up waiting again. Miss another call and you're buying and cooking your own dinners.

mechanism: A imposes escalating dinner consequences for a recurring missed-call pattern while offering practical accommodations to keep B complying with the new arrangement.
confusable: Unlike a one-off meal boundary, A uses each explanation or request as another instance of the same pattern; borrowed authority provides workable food alternatives while raising the cost.
comparison: Dinner timing and cooking duties differ from family-visit cancellation and taking over future arrangements.
seedUse: Use D96-a battery/train/warm dinner/plate/cooking with S02-b practical adaptation while preserving A directed rule.
